Protective Th1 cytokine responses shape the inflammatory lung response to intracellular Francisella.
Lung inflammation manifests clinically as pneumonia after inhalational tularemia.
Systemic inflammatory cytokines produce an acute febrile illness.

Systemic inflammation in acute tularemia produces chills.
